trello.name: Add queue depth alerting to worker fleet
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Set up alerting on queue depth for the entire worker fleet (not just payments), with consistent thresholds everywhere: warning at 1,000 jobs and page at 5,000 jobs. This addresses the 16-minute blind spot during Tuesday's outage where no alert fired until customer-facing 500s appeared.

trello.name: Fix payment worker retry logic with dead-letter queue
trello.desc: Owner: Marta. Fix the retry loop in payment_worker.py (_process_with_retry function) which currently retries five times back-to-back with no backoff and re-enqueues failed jobs at the front of the queue. Implement exponential backoff with jitter, cap the retries, and send failed jobs to a dead-letter queue at the back instead of the front of the main queue. Add tests that simulate processor 503s to cover the retry storm scenario that was uncovered by this incident.

trello.name: Bump and split DB connection pools
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. In one change to the same config file: (1) bump the DB connection pool from the default of 20 to 100 to get through the next incident, and (2) split worker and API connection pools so workers no longer share the API's pool, which is the real fix for the coupling that caused the API to fail when workers exhausted the pool.

trello.name: Update payment incident runbook
trello.desc: Owner: Priya (Kofi to confirm assignment with her after the meeting). Update the payment incident runbook which still references the old Kibana (turned off in March). Include: new logging links, the queue drain procedure Kofi improvised during Tuesday's outage written down formally, and verification that escalation phone numbers are current (at least one still routes to someone who left last year).

trello.name: Automate status page updates on checkout alert
trello.desc: Owner: Marta. Automate the status page so that when the checkout error rate alert fires, the status page automatically flips to 'investigating' with a template message, using the status provider's API. Wire it to the checkout alert first; other alerts can be extended later. This addresses the 30-minute delay in updating the status page during Tuesday's outage, which generated ~50 support tickets.

trello.name: Draft payment processor failover game day plan
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Draft a plan for a controlled chaos test (game day) of the payment processor failover. Plan should cover testing in staging first, then production during a low-traffic window, with a rollback plan. The secondary payment processor is configured but has never been exercised. Draft only — no execution until the plan is reviewed by the team in two weeks.

trello.name: Upgrade Redis from EOL 6.0 to 7.2
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Upgrade Redis from version 6.0 (security fixes ended in June) to 7.2. The migration involves a config rename and changed persistence defaults, so it requires a proper change window scheduled with the infra calendar — not a casual Friday deploy. Not related to the outage but flagged as infra debt.

trello.name: Write and distribute outage timeline document
trello.desc: Owner: Ines. Write up the timeline document for Tuesday's outage tonight and send it out tomorrow. Should cover the full postmortem timeline and the seven agreed action items with their owners.
